items.question: How often is the Official Gazette of Abu Dhabi issued?
items.gold: It is issued on a monthly basis, in Arabic and English.
items.fact: Abu Dhabi Official Gazette issued monthly in Arabic and English

items.question: In what year did the first issue of the Official Gazette of Abu Dhabi appear?
items.fact: First Abu Dhabi Official Gazette issue dates back to 1965
